label: NOTE: what this set reaches, and the claim it exists for
why: The seven V92CP members below the constructor were read from .text+0x4e5d0-0x4ebdb in one sitting, so a green t_v92cpcrc says our reading and the object agree and not that either is right. THE ENTRY THAT MATTERS MOST is 'the shift register is updated in place': the object copies all sixteen stages into stack slots before the loop and back after it, and a version that worked on crc[] directly behaves identically for every message shorter than the bit vector -- the two separate only once the loop's index reaches 2000, where crc begins and the register starts feeding on itself. Three cases in t_v92cpcrc.cpp go there on purpose. WHAT NO ENTRY HERE REACHES: a length below seventeen, which wraps the unsigned bound and runs the loop off the address space on both sides -- docs/deviations.md D504, and a mutation of it would crash rather than be caught.
